describe.description: A single quadrupedal creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on flat ground against a plain off-white background. The animal has a low, stout body with an arched back and a long tapering tail extending to the left. The head, underside, and limbs are pale gray with slightly pinkish and bluish tones, smooth and wrinkled skin, and small dark speckles on the head. Behind the head on the neck are six pink feathery external gills. The entire dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the tip of the tail is covered in overlapping large brown and dark gray scales. The creature stands on four short thick limbs with clawed feet, and its belly shows pale transverse wrinkling. The overall appearance combines amphibian-like head and limbs with a scaled armored back and tail.

describe.description: A stout quadrupedal creature shown in side-three-quarter view facing right. It has a broad pale gray amphibian head with large round eyes, small nostrils, and a wide mouth, with pink feathery external gills fanning out from behind the head on both sides. Its underside and four thick wrinkled limbs are pale amphibian skin, the limbs ending in slender clawed toes. The entire back, flanks, and long tapering tail are covered in overlapping dark brown-gray pointed scales, the tail extending to the left beyond the frame.
